body: Clouded residue from the treated rows streaks the kit and bottle. It was set aside after the flies vanished from the barn. The cattle began to cough.
title: First-aid kit and water bottle

body: The kit is unopened, with a stenciled cordon number on the lid. The bottle has a black line halfway down, repeated on the burnt wall. Looks like measuring what survived the fire, not treating a burn.
title: First-aid kit and water bottle
